name: Gargazon (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Gargazon (a tower on white above three trees on red).
history: Municipal flag of Gargazon, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Gargazon arms — tower on white above three trees on red
